tools.description: Code intelligence from the project's language servers (for example gopls, pyright, typescript-language-server, rust-analyzer): exact answers where grep guesses. diagnostics lists the compiler and linter errors and warnings of a file as the server sees it now (use it after an edit). definition, references, type_definition and implementation find where a symbol is declared, used, typed or implemented; hover shows its type and documentation; symbols outlines a file; workspace_symbols searches symbol names across the project (path picks the language). Point at a symbol with line (1-based) and either column (1-based) or symbol, its text on that line. Results are file:line:column with the line's text. The server sees the files as saved on disk.

action.description: What to ask the language server.

column.description: 1-based column of the symbol on line.

line.description: 1-based line of the symbol (definition, references, hover, type_definition, implementation).

path.description: File, relative to cwd or absolute. Its extension picks the language server.

query.description: workspace_symbols: part of the symbol name to search for.

symbol.description: The symbol's text on line, instead of column; its first occurrence on the line is used.

tools.name: lsp
